requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure no account can have a negative balance and automatically withdraw funds from a related saving account when necessary.
The ATM system shall implement a dynamic transaction processing system, allowing expedited processing for low-risk transactions while maintaining strict safety checks for high-risk transactions.
The ATM system shall integrate energy-efficient practices in transaction processing and automatic withdrawals to minimize environmental impact.
The ATM system shall provide comprehensive transaction logging, including date, time, type, amount, and updated balance, for audit and compliance purposes.
The ATM system shall notify users immediately of insufficient funds to prevent unauthorized transactions.
The ATM system shall encrypt all transactions during transmission to ensure user data security.
